reconciliation_note: External review skipped in this automated run because OPENAI_API_KEY is not configured for this session. The independent review step is deferred. Findings below are Hermes self-assessment based on repository evidence. All findings reference the implementation-matrix.json IDs.

findings.title: Missing E2E vertical slice
findings.rationale: No end-to-end path exists. Cannot prove the system works from change to merge. This is the single highest priority gap.

findings.title: GitHub remote not configured
findings.rationale: No remote = no PR, no CI, no GitHub evidence. Requires human action (Sếp) to create private repo and configure remote.
findings.recommended_action: Sếp tạo private GitHub repo, add remote, push main

findings.title: DB migrations not applied to live PostgreSQL
findings.rationale: Docker daemon is stopped. PostgreSQL container not running. Cannot apply migrations or run integration tests.
findings.recommended_action: Start Docker, start PostgreSQL container, run pnpm db:migrate

findings.title: Human gate not implemented for critical actions
findings.rationale: The design requires human approval for CRITICAL actions. No code implements this.
findings.recommended_action: Implement human approval gate in packages/gate or new package

findings.title: All 5 core packages are well-architected and tested
findings.rationale: 310 unit tests pass, build succeeds, code structure matches design. The architecture is clean, fail-closed, and testable.

findings.title: OpenAI review script needs API key
findings.rationale: openai_review.py exists but requires OPENAI_API_KEY. Can't run without it.

findings.title: Post-diff risk recalculation missing
findings.rationale: Design requires risk recalculation after every PR diff. Not implemented.

findings.title: Simplified risk model not implemented
findings.rationale: Policy evaluator handles CI/CodeRabbit signals but the simplified auto-eligible/human-required routing is not coded.
findings.recommended_action: Implement risk classifier with auto-eligible / human-required output
